content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Phoenix

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's formal eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your role, responsibilities, and hours. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can clarify whether your background meets the standard.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp. Our instructor-led course covers all five PMBOK® process groups, exam domains, and real-world case studies. You'll complete the full contact-hour requirement in a structured, interactive format—no self-paced modules. Your completion certificate satisfies PMI's formal-education prerequisite for application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After bootcamp completion, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application, including your education, work experience, and training certificate. Pay PMI's exam fee through their portal. PMI reviews applications within five business days; approval unlocks your exam-eligibility window. Granite PM Academy's support team can guide you through each section.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and live Q&A sessions to reinforce bootcamp content and build confidence. Register for your exam through PMI's testing partner at a time and location convenient to you. On exam day, you'll answer 180 multiple-choice questions across the PMBOK® domains and competencies.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Once certified, you'll renew every three years by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, conferences, volunteer work, or mentoring. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to keep your knowledge current and credential active. Plan your renewal strategy early to stay compliant without last-minute pressure.
